signals.title: Camps de regroupement en Algérie : "Une histoire extrêmement inhumaine" et oubliée
signals.summary: Entre 1954 et 1962, l'armée française a déplacé de force dans des camps de regroupements plus de 2 millions de paysans algériens du djebel et des Hauts plateaux. Environ 200 000 personnes y ont trouvé la mort. Dans "Une tragédie occultée de la guerre d'Algérie", la journaliste Lorraine Rossignol livre une enquête sur ces camps de la honte passés sous silence en France comme en Algérie.

signals.title: RDC : la psychose face à la résurgence d'Ébola

signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Barbados Ambassador for Climate Change and Climate Vulnerable Forum representative Elizabeth Thompson has proposed exploring mandatory financing and legally binding mechanisms to compel countries to accelerate methane emissions reduction, warning that voluntary climate commitments are failing to deliver the urgency required to avert catastrophic global warming.

signals.title: Civils tués dans des frappes au lac Tchad : N’Djamena dément les accusations de l’ONU

signals.title: RDC : nouvelle flambée d’Ebola, au moins 65 morts
signals.summary: En République démocratique du Congo, une nouvelle flambée d’Ebola suscite l’inquiétude des autorités sanitaires.

signals.title: Rwandans in Mali Honour Genocide Victims With Call to Fight Denial
signals.summary: [New Times] More than 250 people gathered in Bamako, Mali, on Sunday, May 10, to commemorate the 1994 Genocide against the Tutsi and pay tributes to more than one million victims.

signals.title: Mali Junta Chief Takes Over Defence Minister's Role Amid Criticism From UN
signals.summary: [RFI] The United Nations voiced grave concern Tuesday over reports of extrajudicial killings allegedly conducted by the security forces in Mali, now plunged into crisis following an assault on ruling junta strongholds. signals.title: Mali's Leader Assumes Defense Role After Minister Was Killed in Bombing
signals.summary: [allAfrica] Mali's military leader, Assimi Goïta, has assumed the role of defence minister following the death of Sadio Camara in a suspected suicide bombing during a wave of coordinated attacks.

signals.title: Are Mali's Tuareg-Led FLA Fighters Terrorists or Separatists?
signals.summary: [RFI] A Tuareg-led separatist group in Mali has insists it is not a "terrorist" organisation despite carrying out coordinated attacks with al-Qaeda-linked fighters that hit military targets and killed the country's defence minister last month. The group, known as the Azawad Liberation Front (FLA), was formed in December 2024 and is seeking independence for northern Mali.

signals.summary: Roger Kamba, ministre congolais de la Santé, a tenu, ce samedi 16 mai, une conférence de presse à Kinshasa sur la dix-septième épidémie d’Ebola qui touche la province de l’Ituri, en République démocratique du Congo (RDC). signals.summary: Une nouvelle épidémie d'Ebola a été déclarée vendredi en République démocratique du Congo (RD Congo), l'Ouganda voisin déclarant également dans la soirée l'état d'épidémie après un décès causé par le virus enregistré sur son territoire. signals.summary: Le 16 mai 2025, il y a exactement un an, l’ancien président gabonais Ali Bongo quittait sa résidence de Libreville pour un départ en exil. L’ex-président venait d’obtenir la libération de son épouse Sylvia et de son fils Noureddin Bongo arrêtés puis jetés en prison le soir du coup d’État qui avait renversé son régime le 30 août 2023. signals.title: Nigeria: des dizaines d'enfants enlevés dans l'État de Borno au nord-est du pays
signals.summary: Plusieurs dizaines d’élèves ont potentiellement été enlevés ce vendredi 15 mai par des jihadistes dans le district d’Askira Uba dans l’État de Borno, dans le nord-est du Nigeria. Cette zone, située non loin du village de Chibok où avaient été enlevées 274 lycéennes en 2014, fait l’objet d’une recrudescence d’attaques ces derniers mois, à la fois contre les habitants mais aussi contre des bases de l’armée. Une situation inédite, depuis 1992, diversement vécue et interprétée, à l’entame d’un septennat au cours duquel le chef de l’État a promis une place importante aux jeunes et aux femmes.

Certains les utilisent pour contourner le naira, monnaie du Nigeria, fortement dévalué ces dernières années. D’autres, notamment parmi les jeunes, achètent et revendent des cryptoactifs sur les plateformes d’échange, dans l’espoir de gains rapides. Reportage de Yassin Ciyow.

signals.title: En Mauritanie, les réfugiés maliens entre fragile espoir de retour et crainte d’un nouvel exode
signals.summary: En Mauritanie, plus de 300 000 Maliens poussés à fuir leur pays par la guerre vivent dans des camps de réfugiés. Pour certains, les récentes offensives du FLA et du Jnim contre la junte et ses alliés russes ravivent un espoir prudent de retour.

signals.title: Sommet "Africa Forward", affrontements à Kidal, Christophe Gleizes : l'hebdo Afrique
Shakira, Burna Boy Release Official 2026 FIFA World Cup Song, 'Dai Dai'
signals.summary: [Premium Times] The song was released on Friday via Sony Music Latin.

signals.title: Ex-South African president to appeal order to proceed with graft trial
signals.summary: A judge on Thursday ruled that the decades-long case against Jacob Zuma and French defence company, Thales, should go ahead.

signals.title: Kenyans Vent Fury Over Fuel Price Hike
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Speaking to Capital in the Morning, motorists, traders and commuters said the sharp rise in petrol and diesel prices will directly affect transport costs, food prices and daily household expenses.

signals.title: How Oil Mafia Fought Hard to Stop My Refinery - Aliko Dangote
signals.summary: [Premium Times] Mr Dangote said small groups profited from local product allocations under the subsidy regime and that subsidy payments alone reached nearly $10 billion annually.

signals.title: 'It Is Better I Remain a Fan' - Dangote Explains Why $20bn Refinery Stopped Arsenal Takeover Dream
signals.summary: [Premium Times] The billionaire admitted that prioritising those businesses over football ownership became the only realistic option

signals.title: Un tribunal sud-africain autorise le procès pour corruption de Jacob Zuma et Thales
signals.summary: La date du procès n’a pas encore été fixée

signals.title: De prince à roi : au Maroc, les étapes très codifiées de la préparation au pouvoir
signals.summary: La nomination, au début de mai, du prince Moulay Hassan au poste de coordinateur de l’état-major général de l’armée a suscité quelques interrogations. Elle représente pourtant une étape classique de la préparation des futurs rois du Maroc, déjà observée sous les règnes de Mohammed V et de Hassan II.

signals.title: Afrique du Sud : l’ANC réaffirme son soutien à Cyril Ramaphosa
signals.summary: Le Congrès national africain (ANC), au pouvoir en Afrique du Sud, a réaffirmé son soutien au président Cyril Ramaphosa, visé par une procédure de destitution liée au scandale dit du “Farmgate”.

signals.title: Lawyers Raise Fair Trial Concerns in Diezani's UK Case
signals.summary: [Vanguard] The League of Legal Practitioners of Nigeria, yesterday, questioned the fairness and evidential basis of the ongoing United Kingdom trial involving former Petroleum Minister, Diezani Alison-Madueke, insisting that the case must be determined strictly on credible evidence and proof beyond reasonable doubt.

signals.title: Gabon : Ali Bongo Ondimba, opposant en chef
signals.summary: Renversé mais pas résigné à quitter la scène politique, Ali Bongo Ondimba prépare son retour au cœur du PDG. Depuis son exil parisien, l’ancien président conteste devant la justice sa mise à l’écart de la direction du parti et entend reprendre la main sur l’appareil fondé par son père.

signals.title: Ruto's UDA Wins Big in Narok, Samburu and Elgeyo Marakwet By-Elections
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- The ruling United Democratic Alliance (UDA) party scored a major political victory after winning all the by-elections held on Thursday in Narok, Samburu and Elgeyo Marakwet counties, strengthening President William Ruto's grip ahead of the 2027 political battle.

signals.title: Mudavadi Leads Kenyan Delegation to World Urban Forum 13 in Baku
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Musalia Mudavadi has arrived in Baku, Azerbaijan, leading an advance Kenyan delegation ahead of the World Urban Forum 13 (WUF13) scheduled for May 17-22.

signals.title: ANC closes ranks around Ramaphosa as impeachment pressure mounts
signals.summary: South Africa’s ruling African National Congress gathered for a key meeting as President Cyril Ramaphosa faces renewed impeachment pressure linked to the controversial Farmgate cash-heist scandal.

signals.title: Maroc-Syrie : reprise des relations diplomatiques
signals.summary: Le ministre syrien des Affaires étrangères, Assaad al-Chaibani, a effectué une visite officielle au Maroc, une première depuis la chute de Bachar al-Assad en décembre 2024.

signals.title: Syrian Foreign Minister makes first visit to Morocco since Assad’s fall
signals.summary: Morocco and Syria have taken a major step toward restoring relations, as Syrian Foreign Minister Assaad al-Chaibani visited Rabat for talks with Moroccan Foreign Minister Nasser Bourita. The visit marks the first by a senior Syrian official to Morocco since the fall of Bashar al-Assad.

signals.title: Kenya Keeps Somalia Border Closed Over Security Concerns, Ruto Says
signals.summary: [Shabelle] Nairobi -- Kenyan President William Ruto said Thursday that renewed instability in Somalia had forced Nairobi to keep its border with neighboring Somalia closed, nearly 15 years after the frontier was first shut.

signals.title: Death Toll Hits 191 As Lassa Fever Cases Rise
signals.summary: [Vanguard] ... as NCDC warns of increasing fatality rate

signals.title: Kenya's War On Traditional Alcohol - a Colonial Hangover About What It Means to Be 'Civilised'
signals.summary: [The Conversation Africa] At the dawn of Kenya's colonial era in 1902, consumption of home-made alcohol was deeply embedded in society. For instance, among the Mijikenda of coastal Kenya, palm wine was integral (p.290) to traditional ceremonies, such as marriage and initiations, and in ritual offerings.

signals.title: Au Tchad, l’opposition dénonce un climat politique de plus en plus tendu
signals.summary: Nouvelle alerte de l’opposition tchadienne sur l’état du climat politique dans le pays. En conférence de presse mercredi à N’Djamena, le parti Les Patriotes, membre de l’ex-Groupe de concertation des acteurs politique, le GCAP, a dénoncé ce qu’il décrit comme un durcissement du pouvoir, sur fond de condamnations judiciaires visant plusieurs responsables politiques. Le mouvement évoque également une dégradation de la situation sécuritaire et des fractures communautaires…

signals.title: Afrique du Sud : l'opposition quitte le Parlement pour exiger la démission de Ramaphosa
signals.summary: En Afrique du Sud, les députés de l’opposition ont quitté l’Hémicycle lors d'une séance de questions-réponses du président, pour exprimer leur mécontentement. Cyril Ramaphosa fait l'objet d'accusations de fautes graves, ils exigent sa démission.

signals.title: South Africa: Opposition parties pile pressure on Ramaphosa
signals.summary: Members of South African opposition parties walked out of a question and answer session by President Cyril Ramaphosa, who is facing claims of misconduct by hiding from police and tax authorities a 2020 break-in at one of his homes, and theft of large sums of foreign currency

signals.title: Afrique du Sud : Jacob Zuma de retour devant la justice
signals.summary: Un tribunal sud-africain a ordonné jeudi 14 mai la reprise d’un procès pour corruption, maintes fois reporté, visant l’ex-président Jacob Zuma. Il est accusé d’avoir touché il y a plus de 25 ans des pots-de-vin du groupe français de défense Thales, également poursuivi.

signals.title: Dangote, Zlecaf, minerais critiques : l’Afrique peut-elle forger ses champions ?
signals.summary: De Lagos au Caire, des champions industriels africains atteignent enfin la taille critique. Mais une intégration commerciale inachevée, un accès au capital limité et la tentation des rentes minières freinent encore l’émergence d’un capitalisme continental.

signals.title: Mali : Kidal, sous contrôle rebelle, visée par plusieurs frappes de l’armée malienne
signals.summary: L’armée malienne a mené plusieurs frappes aériennes dans la nuit du 13 au 14 mai à Kidal. Elle assure que les « frappes vont s’accentuer » sur cette ville désormais contrôlée par les rebelles touareg et leurs alliés jihadistes du Jnim.

signals.title: RDC : l’accord conclut avec les États-Unis est "inacceptable" selon le Dr Mukwege
signals.summary: Le médecin congolais Denis Mukwege, lauréat du prix Nobel de la paix 2018, dénonce l'accord de paix négocié par les États-Unis en République démocratique du Congo. Selon le docteur, celui-ci vise davantage à piller les ressources du pays qu'à garantir la sécurité.

signals.title: Nobel winner Mukwege warns of predatory US deal for DR Congo
signals.summary: A US-brokered peace deal in the DR Congo is more focused on plundering the country's resources than offering security, Nobel Peace Prize-winning Congolese doctor Denis Mukwege has said

signals.title: Springboks' Ntlabakanye given 18-month doping ban
signals.summary: South Africa prop Asenathi Ntlabakanye is banned for 18 months for breaking anti-doping rules - ruling him out of the 2027 World Cup.

signals.title: Mali's army carries out overnight strikes on rebel-held city of Kidal
signals.summary: An army officer says it is targeting specific objectives and warned the strikes will be intensifying in the coming days.

signals.title: « On ne doit plus attendre de se faire arnaquer » : à l’Africa CEO Forum, le secteur privé africain sommé de changer d’échelle
signals.summary: Huit chefs d’État et de gouvernement, des dirigeants d’institutions financières internationales et plus de 2 800 décideurs sont réunis ces 14 et 15 mai, à Kigali, pour la 13e édition de l’Africa CEO Forum (ACF), placée sous le thème « scale or fail », avec l’ambition d’atteindre une taille critique.

signals.title: Explainer - What the 2026 PBO Regulations Mean for NGOs and Civil Society in Kenya
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- Kenya's nonprofit and civil society sector is entering a new legal era following the rollout of the Public Benefit Organizations (PBO) Regulations, 2026, which operationalize the Public Benefit Organizations Act, 2013.

signals.title: 10 choses à savoir sur Philippe Lalliot, le nouvel ambassadeur de France au Maroc
signals.summary: Diplomate de crise, homme du Quai d’Orsay et artisan attendu du nouveau chapitre franco-marocain, Philippe Lalliot s’apprête à prendre les rênes d’une ambassade stratégique à l’heure du réchauffement entre Rabat et Paris.

signals.title: Ruto Support Weakening but Fragmented Opposition Could Hand Him 2027 Lifeline - Poll
signals.summary: [Capital FM] Nairobi -- President William Ruto's political dominance appears to be weakening ahead of the 2027 General Election, but a deeply fragmented opposition could still hand him a second term, according to a new national survey by TIFA Research.

signals.title: Former Nigerian minister sentenced to 75 years in rare corruption verdict
signals.summary: Former Power Minister Saleh Mamman was convicted last week - but the authorities do not know his whereabouts.

signals.title: Cameroon uncovers more than 200 illegal gold mines, mostly foreign-owned
signals.summary: Nearly 200 illegal artisanal gold mining companies, most of them foreign-owned, have been uncovered in central and eastern Cameroon, the mines ministry said Wednesday.

signals.title: Tunisia tourism feels pressure as regional war drives up travel costs
signals.summary: Industry officials blame the fallout from the conflict, which has sent oil prices and travel costs skyrocketing, even thousands of miles away in Tunisia's idyllic island of Djerba.

signals.title: Cameroun : le Colonel Hamad Kalkaba Malboum s'est éteint à l'âge de 75 ans
signals.summary: Il laisse derrière lui l'image d'un homme qui aura profondément marqué le sport africain

signals.title: Centrafrique : Faustin-Archange Touadéra, arbitre contraint du duel Sarandji-Ngamana
signals.summary: Alors qu’il semblait promis à la vice-présidence de la République, Simplice Mathieu Sarandji a été reconduit à la tête de l’Assemblée nationale que lorgnait son rival, Évariste Ngamana. Un retournement validé par Faustin-Archange Touadéra, qui n’en a pas fini avec cette rivalité.

signals.title: Rwanda Confirms Tanzania, Comoros Friendlies During Camp in Morocco
signals.summary: [New Times] Rwanda will face Tanzania and Comoros in international friendly matches during the June FIFA international window, according to Rwanda FA Secretary General Bonnie Mugabe.

signals.title: Africa CEO Forum 2026 : à Kigali, l’Afrique des affaires veut changer d’échelle
signals.summary: Réunis à Kigali pour l’Africa CEO Forum 2026, les principaux dirigeants et décideurs publics et privés qui œuvrent sur le continent veulent accélérer la montée en puissance des champions locaux. Dans un contexte international plus dur, le mot d’ordre est clair : atteindre enfin la taille critique.

signals.title: All You Need to Know About the TotalEnergies CAF U-17 Africa Cup of Nations Morocco 2026
signals.summary: [Cosafa] Africa's next generation of football stars will once again step into the spotlight when the TotalEnergies CAF U-17 Africa Cup of Nations Morocco 2026 kicks off on 13 May and runs until 02 June 2026.

signals.title: Nigerian film star Alexx Ekubo dies from cancer aged 40
signals.summary: The actor was recognised for his contributions to entertainment as well as his humanitarian efforts.

signals.title: 'They shot my neighbour in the head' - the lakeside city traumatised by war
signals.summary: Rebel fighters and Rwandan troops are accused of committing atrocities after capturing the DR Congo city of Uvira in December.

signals.title: Guinée : Yéro Baldé de nouveau candidat aux élections législatives et locales
signals.summary: En Guinée, Yéro Baldé, principal opposant au président Mamadi Doumbouya, avait récemment suspendu sa participation au processus électoral. Il dénonçait plusieurs violations du code électoral et des irrégularités dans l’organisation du scrutin. Mais selon les responsables de sa formation politique, la Cour suprême guinéenne, la plus haute juridiction du pays, a finalement décidé de le rétablir dans ses droits, lui permettant ainsi de reprendre part au futur scrutin du 31 mai.

signals.title: Sahel, RD Congo et bilan africain... Ce qu'il faut retenir de l'interview d'Emmanuel Macron
signals.summary: À l'issue du sommet "Africa Forward" organisé à Nairobi par la France et le Kenya lundi et mardi, Emmanuel Macron a répondu aux questions de France 24, RFI et TV5 Monde. L'occasion aussi, pour le chef de l'État, de revenir sur son bilan africain alors que son second quinquennat prend fin dans un an.

signals.title: Afcon final 'deficiencies' dealt with - Motsepe
signals.summary: Confederation of African Football president Patrice Motsepe admits to errors following the chaotic Afcon final between Morocco and Senegal which dented Caf's reputation.

signals.title: Dozens of dogs rescued and suspect arrested in Uganda after BBC investigation
signals.summary: A BBC investigation exposed how scammers posted social content of dogs in distress to dupe donors into giving money.

signals.title: Abdul Samad Rabiu (BUA), avocat optimiste de la souveraineté économique, désigné « CEO of the year »
signals.summary: Le fondateur du groupe BUA a reçu le 14 mai à Kigali le prix du « CEO of the year », lors de l’Africa CEO Forum.

signals.title: Ghana to evacuate 300 from South Africa over anti-immigrant protests
signals.summary: The foreign minister says the "distressed" Ghanaians registered with the embassy in Pretoria to be evacuated.

signals.title: Débriefing de l'interview évènement d'Emmanuel Macron
signals.summary: À l'issue du sommet "Africa Forward" organisé à Nairobi par la France et le Kenya lundi et mardi, Emmanuel Macron a répondu aux questions de France 24, RFI et TV5 Monde. L'occasion aussi, pour le chef de l'État, de revenir sur son bilan africain. Meriem Amellal revient sur cette interview avec Jean-Claude Félix Tchicaya chercheur à l’Institut de Prospectives et de Sécurité en Europe (IPSE) et Gilles Yabi fondateur et directeur du think tank citoyen WATHI.

signals.title: Africa Forward, une deuxième journée plus politique
signals.summary: À Nairobi au Kenya, après une première journée consacrée aux investissements et au business, le sommet Africa Forward entre dans sa phase politique ce mardi 12 mai 2026. Une trentaine de dirigeants africains réunis autour d’Emmanuel Macron et William Ruto participent à plusieurs tables rondes sur les grands enjeux du continent.

signals.title: REPLAY - L'interview d'Emmanuel Macron à l'issue du sommet "Africa Forward"
signals.summary: En clôture du sommet "Africa Forward", Emmanuel Macron a répondu aux questions des journalistes de RFI, France 24 et TV5MONDE depuis Nairobi. Situation au Mali et en RD Congo, partenariat économique, politique migratoire… Le chef de l'État est longuement revenu sur son bilan africain alors que son second quinquennat prend fin dans un an.

signals.title: Ethiopian marathon runner Melese dies aged 36
signals.summary: Ethiopian long-distance runner Yebrgual Melese dies at the age of 36 after falling ill during a routine training session.

signals.title: France seeks to move beyond colonial ties by meeting African leaders in Kenya
signals.summary: In a first since these meetings started in the 1970s, this move reflects a change in France's thinking.

signals.title: Macron unveils $800m Kenya logistics deal during Nairobi visit
signals.summary: The French container shipping group CMA CGM will invest in Mombasa logistics infrastructure, reinforcing Kenya’s ambitions to become a gateway for East and Central Africa.

signals.title: SA's Ismail reverses retirement for T20 World Cup
signals.summary: South Africa fast bowler Shabnim Ismail reverses her international retirement and is included in the Proteas' squad for this summer's T20 World Cup in England.

signals.title: Africa Forward : finie la Françafrique ?
signals.summary: En ouverture du sommet Africa Forward devant des forces vives de la jeunesse de Nairobi, Emmanuel Macron vante l'initiative privée par contraste avec l'aide au développement et les relations institutionnelles d'Etat à Etat, qui ont caractérisé la Françafrique. Un vrai changement ? On va plus loin avec Niagalé Bagayoko et Florent Rodo.

signals.title: "Africa Forward" : l'occasion pour les entreprises de "se positionner" et de trouver des partenaires
signals.summary: Le sommet "Africa Forward" a débuté lundi au Kenya avec un "business forum" dédié au renforcement des liens économiques entre la France et l'Afrique. Des milliers d'entreprises du continent et de l'Hexagone y ont participé à l'université de Nairobi pour étendre leurs réseaux dans l'optique, plus ou moins lointaine, de décrocher des contrats.

signals.title: South Africa President Cyril Ramaphosa: ‘I will not resign’
signals.summary: South Africa’s president defies calls for him to resign following a ruling by the highest court that parliament should reconsider a report that could lead to his impeachment.

signals.title: Zimbabwe: How political elites are protecting destructive ghost miners in gold rush
signals.summary: Residents in Redcliff say politically connected miners are blasting through mountains, damaging homes and operating behind armed guards while authorities look the other way.

signals.title: Évariste Ndayishimiye: ‘Rwanda has malicious intentions towards Burundi’
signals.summary: The Burundi and current African Union president defends his country’s position against accusations from Rwanda that it is fuelling sub-regional tensions by sending troops to support the Congolese army.

signals.title: SIB Q1 Profit Jumps 11 Percent As Ivorian Economy Holds Course
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Societe Ivoirienne de Banque (BRVM: SIBC) delivered a strong start to 2026, with net profit up 11% in the first quarter against the same period last year, as both its loan book and deposit base expanded and cost discipline held.

signals.title: Vivo Energy Profit Rises 13 Percent in 2025 but Aviation Slump Clouds Q1
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Vivo Energy Cote d'Ivoire (BRVM: SHEC) grew its 2025 net profit 13% to 6.03 billion FCFA ($10.8m), helped by a 5% rise in volumes -- particularly in butane and lubricants -- and a reduction in its bank borrowing costs. Revenue was broadly flat at 605 billion FCFA ($1.08bn).

signals.title: Ivorian Tobacco Maker Sitab Sees Higher Revenue, Lower Profits in 2025
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Societe Ivoirienne des Tabacs (BRVM: STBC) posted higher revenue but lower profits in 2025, as a steep rise in excise duties ate into margins -- and then distributed virtually everything it earned back to its British parent.

signals.title: Financing Costs Overwhelm Bernabe Cote d'Ivoire Earnings in 2025
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Bernabe Cote d'Ivoire (BRVM: BNBC), a hardware and building materials distributor founded in 1953, posted a net profit of just 22.3 million FCFA ($39,900) in 2025 on revenue of 45.3 billion FCFA ($81m) -- a margin so thin it barely registers. The company is operationally sound but financially trapped.

signals.title: 'Total lack of respect': Macron interrupts speaker to ask for silence
signals.summary: The French president stood up during a conference in Kenya to tell the audience to quieten down, saying it was “impossible” for speakers to be heard.

signals.title: Mayor Charged After Alleging Ruling Party Stole His Election Victory
signals.summary: [MFWA] Assalé Tiémoko Antoine, mayor of Tiassalé, was taken into custody following an interrogation by police which lasted for nearly 14 hours in Abidjan on April 22, 2026 over remarks he made during an interview.

signals.title: Nigeria 2027: Atiku, Obi and Kwankwaso’s split widens Tinubu’s reelection path
signals.summary: What was meant to be Nigeria’s biggest opposition alliance against President Bola Tinubu is rapidly unravelling, with rival ambitions, defections and mistrust now threatening to split anti-APC votes ahead of 2027.

signals.title: Lens and Mali Midfielder Sangaré Wins Marc-Vivien Foé Prize for African Players
signals.summary: [RFI] Malian midfielder Mamadou Sangaré has been crowned the 2026 Prix Marc-Vivien Foé winner, as Ligue 1's outstanding African player.

signals.title: Malian Filmmaker Captures Disappearing Tuareg Culture and Traditions
signals.summary: [RFI] In Undertows: A Tuareg Tale, Malian film director Intagrist el Ansari captures the way of life of his people - the Tuaregs. Filmed over 10 years in nomadic settlements and refugee camps, the documentary bears witness to a world "that no longer quite exists".

signals.title: Separatists Hold Many Malian Soldiers Captive
signals.summary: [Premium Times] Many of the soldiers were captured after the military position in Kidal was taken over by a joint force of separatists and jihadists.

signals.title: Bal - Who Are Tigers' Opponents Fus Rabat
signals.summary: [New Times] Moroccan side FUS Rabat will face Rwanda's RSSB Tigers in the quarterfinals of the Basketball Africa League (BAL) playoffs, set for May 22-31 in Kigali.

signals.title: Senegalese, Benin Influencers Highlight Importance of Collaboration
signals.summary: [ENA] Addis Ababa -- Influential digital creators from across Africa are gathering in Addis Ababa for the African Social Media Influencers Summit (ASMIS) 2026, underscoring the growing importance of collaboration, knowledge-sharing, and unified storytelling in shaping the continent's global image.

signals.title: Onatel Grows Revenue but Costs Keep Profits Under Pressure
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] ONATEL (BRVM: ONTBF), the Burkina Faso telecom operator that trades as Moov Africa and is 61% owned by Morocco's Maroc Telecom, grew its customer base and revenue in the first quarter of 2026 but could not prevent profit from falling as operational costs continued to compress margins.

signals.title: Palm Ci Q1 Profit Drops but Company Says Backlog to Clear in H2
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] PALM Cote d'Ivoire (BRVM: PALC), the Abidjan-based palm oil producer, posted net profit of 1.6 billion FCFA ($2.9 million) in the first quarter of 2026, down 86% from 11.6 billion FCFA ($20.7 million) a year earlier, as lower volumes and weaker prices hit both revenue and margins simultaneously.

signals.title: Ecobank Ci Grows Q1 Revenue but Rising Risk Costs Weigh On Profit
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Ecobank Côte d'Ivoire (BRVM: ECOC) started 2026 with net banking income growing 3.7% to 30.8 billion FCFA ($55.1 million), a solid top-line performance in a market where the bank is operating with deliberate caution on credit.

signals.title: TotalEnergies Senegal Profit Grows Despite Pump Price Cut
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] TotalEnergies Marketing Senegal, the BRVM-listed fuel retailer and 69.1% subsidiary of TotalEnergies, posted net profit of 1.59 billion FCFA ($2.8 million) in the first quarter of 2026, up 5% from 1.51 billion FCFA ($2.7 million) a year earlier -- a result that masks a more interesting story underneath the headline.

signals.title: Bernabé Swings to Loss As New Division Weighs On Earnings
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] Bernabé Côte d'Ivoire, the Abidjan-based industrial supplies and building materials distributor, swung to a net loss of 65.6 million FCFA ($117,200) in the first quarter of 2026, reversing a profit of 16.1 million FCFA ($28,800) in the same period of 2025, as the integration of a new business division created a drag on earnings.

signals.title: SMB Sees Sharp Profit Drop On Maintenance Halt, Oil Price Surge
signals.summary: [Daba Finance] SMB, the Abidjan bitumen refiner, saw profit fall 45% in the first quarter of 2026 to 1.49 billion FCFA ($2.7 million) from 2.71 billion FCFA ($4.9 million) a year earlier -- a result shaped by two distinct events that arrived simultaneously and reinforced each other.

signals.title: Mali Is the Linchpin of West Africa - Now It's Under Jihadist Siege
signals.summary: [CFR] An unusual alliance between armed groups in Mali could embolden others in neighboring countries and put Russia's foothold in the region at risk.

signals.title: Senegal Rebel Leader Rejects Prosecution Claims Against Journalist René Capain Bassène
signals.summary: [CPJ] A key Senegalese rebel leader, César Atoute Badiate, has broken his silence on jailed journalist René Capain Bassène, refuting the prosecution's claim that Bassène was a militant fighting for independence of the Casamance region who incited him to murder 14 illegal loggers in 2018.

signals.title: New CPJ Podcast Reveals Torture, Coerced Testimony in Case of Jailed Senegalese Journalist René Capain Bassène
signals.summary: [CPJ] Dakar -- A new podcast released by the Committee to Protect Journalists (CPJ) presents extensive new testimony and reporting on the conviction of Senegalese journalist and author René Capain Bassène, raising serious questions about the integrity of a case that has become one of West Africa's most emblematic press freedom concerns.

signals.title: Far Rabat's Long 41-Year Wait for Another Shot At the Trophy
signals.summary: [CAF] FAR Rabat will step onto the continental stage once again next week with history within reach, as the Moroccan giants prepare to face South Africa's Mamelodi Sundowns in the two-legged final of the 2025/26 TotalEnergies CAF Champions League.

signals.title: BBC uncovers the Ugandan scammers abusing dogs to elicit donations from animal lovers
signals.summary: Unwitting donors hand over money to save suffering animals but Ugandan con artists pocket the cash.

signals.title: Kenya battles to stop the 'goons and guns' as fears of political violence grow
signals.summary: More than 100 gangs are operating nationwide as the growing use of political thugs raises fears of election violence.
